create table round_table(
    id int,
    name varchar(20),
    salary int
)
with(
    distribution = ROUND_ROBIN
)


insert into round_table VALUES(1,'sathvik', 5000)

select * from round_table




create schema gold



create table gold.dim_product(
    dim_key_prod int,
    prod_id int,
    prod_name VARCHAR(4000)
)
with(
    DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE
)




create table gold.claimfact(
    dim_key_prod int,
    revenue int,
    cost int
)
with(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(dim_key_prod)
)
